module.purpose: Implements dehydration and hydration of query and mutation caches for TanStack Query to support SSR and state transfer.
module.summary: This module provides functions to serialize (dehydrate) and restore (hydrate) query and mutation states from a QueryClient. It defines options for custom serializers, error redaction, and filters for choosing which entries to persist. Hydration carefully avoids overwriting newer client data and reconciles pending promises, ensuring cache consistency across server and client.
module.businessContext: Enables SSR and seamless client-server state transfer for data fetching. Failure causes hydration mismatches or lost cache.

units.name: dehydrate

detail.name: dehydrate
detail.signature: export function dehydrate(client: QueryClient, options: DehydrateOptions = {}): DehydratedState
preconditions: client must be a valid QueryClient instance with accessible mutation and query caches
options if provided must conform to the DehydrateOptions shape
postconditions: Returns a DehydratedState containing dehydrated mutations that pass the resolved filter function
Errors in the dehydrated state are redacted according to the resolved shouldRedactErrors function
Data in the dehydrated state is serialized according to the resolved serializeData function
invariants: Each option (shouldDehydrateMutation, shouldDehydrateQuery, shouldRedactErrors, serializeData) is resolved via a fallback chain: options → client.getDefaultOptions().dehydrate → hardcoded default
The returned DehydratedState is a new object; the client and its caches are not mutated
edgeCases: When options is {} (default), all options fall back to client defaults or hardcoded defaults
When a filter function returns false for a mutation, that mutation is excluded from the result
When shouldRedactErrors returns true (default), errors are stripped from the dehydrated state
detail.ioFormatSpec: Returns a DehydratedState object containing a mutations array of DehydratedMutation objects; the state is intended for serialization and transfer between server and client environments.
detail.summary: Constructs a serializable DehydratedState from a QueryClient's mutation and query caches, applying configurable filters to determine which mutations and queries to include, redacting errors, and serializing data.

specTests.then: The custom filter function is used to determine which mutations are included in the returned DehydratedState, not the client default or hardcoded default
defaultShouldDehydrateMutation is used to filter mutations, and only mutations passing that filter appear in the returned state
That mutation is excluded from the mutations array in the returned DehydratedState

units.name: hydrate

detail.name: hydrate
detail.signature: export function hydrate(client: QueryClient, dehydratedState: unknown, options?: HydrateOptions): void
preconditions: dehydratedState must be an object and not null for any hydration to occur
client must be a valid QueryClient exposing getMutationCache, getQueryCache, getDefaultOptions
postconditions: mutations from dehydratedState are built into the mutation cache
queries are built or updated in query cache with deserialized data and corrected status/fetchStatus
if dehydratedState is not an object or is null, client remains unchanged and function returns
invariants: existing queries with strictly newer dataUpdatedAt or newer sync data are never overwritten by older dehydrated state
pending queries that have data after dehydration are marked success with idle fetchStatus unless the existing query is actively fetching
edgeCases: dehydratedState is null or non-object => early return, no mutations to caches
dehydratedState.mutations or .queries undefined => treated as empty array
query with same hash exists and has newer dataUpdatedAt => its state is not overwritten
query exists, was pending, and syncData provides data => status set to success, dataUpdatedAt set to dehydratedAt or Date.now()
dehydrated query contains promise => tryResolveSync is used to extract synchronous data

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: if dehydratedState is not an object or is null, function returns without throwing (no-op)

detail.summary: Restores queries and mutations into a QueryClient from a dehydrated state, preserving newer existing data and promoting pending queries that resolved to data to success status.

existing query fetchStatus that is preserved if actively fetching
